name: What is the typical cost of AI SEO services for a business law firm?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost of AI SEO services for a business law firm?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AI SEO services for a business law firm can vary significantly based on factors such as the firm's size, its current online presence, the competitiveness of its practice areas, and the scope of services required. Packages often range from monthly retainers for ongoing optimization to project-based fees for specific campaigns or audits. Key elements influencing cost include the depth of AI analysis, content creation needs, technical SEO improvements, and reporting frequency. A detailed proposal tailored to your firm's specific goals is usually provided after an initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI SEO costs for law firms vary by firm size, current online presence, practice area competitiveness, and service scope; expect monthly retainers or project fees.
